prompts.name: block_atlas
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production texture atlas for a Minecraft Java industrial mod, named Civitas Industria. Generate a square 1024 by 1024 image, fully opaque. This is a flat orthographic UV texture atlas, NOT a rendered building or scene. Divide the canvas into an EXACT 4 by 4 grid of sixteen contiguous equal square texture panels, with boundaries precisely at 0, 256, 512, 768, 1024 on both axes. Absolutely no gaps, labels, borders outside the tiles, text, captions, shadows cast outside tiles, perspective or isometric geometry. Each panel is designed as crisp 32 by 32 logical-pixel Minecraft pixel art enlarged by nearest-neighbor to 256 square: obvious square pixels, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing. Consistent worn iron, charcoal steel, tarnished brass, warm wood and muted industrial teal; restrained wear and high legibility at small size. Original designs with functional industrial visual language, not copies of existing mod textures. Tile order LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM: row 1: (1) riveted dark steel machine casing with inset metal plate, (2) factory control panel with two small amber indicator lamps and a square dark screen, a brass lever and narrow lower vent, (3) the same kind of factory control panel with bright green running lamps and softly lit screen, (4) machine top with circular brass service hatch and corner bolts. Row 2: (5) strapped warm wooden cargo crate side with sturdy iron corner braces, (6) matching crate lid of cross-braced wooden planks and metal straps, (7) warehouse access door with dark recessed horizontal freight opening and understated ochre safety corners, (8) steel warehouse casing with central reinforced crossbrace. Row 3: (9) freight loader front with a simple bold copper arrow pointing downward into a rectangular inlet, (10) freight unloader front with a simple bold copper arrow pointing upward from a rectangular outlet, (11) tank side with vertical blue fluid sight glass in an iron frame and brass pipe joints, (12) tank top with concentric steel hatch and small brass valve. Row 4: (13) civic control panel: cream enamel plate, small brass geometric four-quadrant civic emblem, teal status lamp, (14) defense panel with a plain riveted steel shield emblem and small amber lamp, (15) maintenance/remediation panel with two small blue and green liquid gauges, brass valve and teal ventilation grille, (16) decorative machinery material: large centered brass cog with dark hub against recessed charcoal casing. Every tile fills its own square completely, all elements lie on the same flat material plane. Keep the panel surfaces chunky, readable, tactile and consistent with vanilla-scale voxel blocks. Output only the atlas.
